name: RivNet
summary: Wagga Wagga / Riverina NSW regional ISP (rivnet.com.au); live site 2012-2016, then defunct (domain parked). Founding year unconfirmed (2M SYSTEMS PTY LTD, ACN 613 465 900).

events.details: Legal-entity candidate HELD: 2M Systems Pty Ltd (ACN 613 465 900, Riverland SA) holds the 'Rivnet' business name only from 2026, while this Riverina NSW ISP dates from 2005; the earlier operator is unresolved. Not added to summary pending verification.
